description: Flat metadata schema for individual samples of airborne microbial communities collected in urban environments and profiled by 18S rRNA gene sequencing, including location, season, air quality, and sequencing descriptors.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual air sample record.

collection_date.descr: Date when the air sample was collected (ISO 8601 format, e.g. 2026-03-15).

collection_time_local.descr: Local clock time of sample collection (24-hour format, e.g. 14:30).

city_name.descr: Name of the city where the sample was collected.

country_name.descr: Country where the sample was collected.

site_name.descr: Specific sampling site name or code within the city.

site_type.descr: Urban land-use category of the sampling location; recommended values include industrial, park, residential, commercial, roadside, institutional, or mixed.

latitude.descr: Sampling location latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).

longitude.descr: Sampling location longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).

elevation_m.descr: Elevation of the sampling site above sea level, in meters.

sampling_height_m.descr: Height above ground at which the air sample was collected, in meters.

sampling_device.descr: Device or sampler used for airborne microbial collection, e.g. filter sampler, impinger, cyclone.

sampling_duration_h.descr: Duration of air sampling in hours.

air_volume_m3.descr: Total volume of air sampled, in cubic meters.

filter_material.descr: Filter or collection medium used for sampling, if applicable, e.g. PTFE, quartz, cellulose.

filter_pore_size_um.descr: Filter pore size in micrometers, if applicable.

sample_matrix.descr: Material collected from air, e.g. filter, liquid trap, or swab from sampler surface.

season.descr: Season during which the sample was collected; recommended values include winter, spring, summer, autumn/fall.

temperature_c.descr: Ambient air temperature at sampling time, in degrees Celsius.

relative_humidity_percent.descr: Relative humidity at sampling time, as a percentage (0-100).

particulate_matter_pm10_ug_m3.descr: Concentration of PM10 at sampling time, in micrograms per cubic meter (µg/m3).

particulate_matter_pm2_5_ug_m3.descr: Concentration of PM2.5 at sampling time, in micrograms per cubic meter (µg/m3).

particulate_matter_pm1_ug_m3.descr: Concentration of PM1 at sampling time, in micrograms per cubic meter (µg/m3), if measured.

wind_speed_m_s.descr: Wind speed at sampling time, in meters per second.

wind_direction_deg.descr: Wind direction at sampling time, in degrees from north (0-360).

precipitation_mm.descr: Precipitation during or prior to sampling window, in millimeters.

sampling_replicate_id.descr: Identifier for a technical or biological replicate of the same sampling event, if applicable.

collection_protocol.descr: Short description or code for the sample collection protocol used.

dna_extraction_method.descr: Method or kit used for DNA extraction from the air sample.

pcr_target_region.descr: Targeted 18S rRNA gene region amplified, e.g. V4, V9, or specific primer-defined region.

forward_primer_sequence.descr: Forward primer sequence used for amplification, written 5' to 3'.

reverse_primer_sequence.descr: Reverse primer sequence used for amplification, written 5' to 3'.

pcr_cycles.descr: Number of PCR amplification cycles used.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument/platform, e.g. Illumina MiSeq, NovaSeq.

sequencing_layout.descr: Read layout, e.g. single-end or paired-end.

read_length_bp.descr: Nominal read length in base pairs.

library_preparation_kit.descr: Library preparation kit or protocol used for sequencing library construction.

raw_read_count.descr: Total number of raw sequencing reads generated for the sample.

filtered_read_count.descr: Number of reads retained after quality filtering.

chimera_filtered_read_count.descr: Number of reads retained after chimera removal.

otu_asv_count.descr: Number of OTUs or ASVs detected in the sample.

alpha_diversity_observed_richness.descr: Observed richness metric for the sample, if computed.

alpha_diversity_shannon.descr: Shannon diversity index for the sample, if computed.

taxon_name.descr: Assigned taxonomic name for the record if the table is taxon-level; use the most specific resolved rank available.

taxon_rank.descr: Taxonomic rank of taxon_name, e.g. kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species, ASV.

taxon_id.descr: Stable taxonomic identifier from a reference database, if available.

taxon_relative_abundance_percent.descr: Relative abundance of the taxon in the sample, expressed as a percentage (0-100), if the record is taxon-level.

taxon_read_count.descr: Number of reads assigned to the taxon in the sample, if the record is taxon-level.

db_reference_name.descr: Reference database used for taxonomic assignment, e.g. SILVA, PR2, UNITE.

alpha_diversity_metric_name.descr: Name of any alpha diversity metric reported for the record, if metrics are stored in long format.

beta_diversity_metric_name.descr: Name of any beta diversity metric or distance measure associated with the sample, if applicable.

qaqc_passed.descr: Whether the sample passed predefined quality-control checks.

negative_control_included.descr: Whether a negative control was included in the extraction or PCR batch.

positive_control_included.descr: Whether a positive control was included in the extraction or PCR batch.

contamination_flag.descr: Indicates suspected contamination or anomalous microbial signal in the sample.

public_health_context.descr: Brief note on any public-health-relevant context, such as proximity to traffic, hospitals, or pollution hotspots.

study_notes.descr: Free-text notes capturing unusual sampling conditions, deviations from protocol, or other relevant observations.
